25K likes, 3,679 comments - ilunarang on March 26, 2026: "Everyone is talking about Kenya, but they have no idea that this visa free island is right next to it.

This is Zanzibar 🇹🇿 

- It is visa free for Indians
- it has the most crystal clear blue water I've ever seen.
- You can enjoy so many activities like scuba diving, Kitesurfing, snorkelling, cave visit, sunset boat rides etc.
- You will find white sand powdery beaches
- Indian and vegetarian food are both easily available
